note: Evaluator-side recall manifest for QA runs against the Sentry repository itself. Never copy it into an investigated workspace. Each entry is a defect a past run reproduced and that is still open; remove an entry when the defect is fixed.

fixtures.title: Sentry repository: previously reproduced, still open defects
fixtures.intendedBehavior: Snapshots preserve literal filenames; workspace cleanup removes only workspace-shaped parents.

knownDefects.summary: A file whose name contains a backslash is manifested with the backslash turned into a slash, colliding with a real nested path and restoring to the wrong location.
knownDefects.expectedBehavior: The snapshot manifest preserves the literal filename and round-trips it, or rejects names it cannot represent.
knownDefects.actualBehavior: Two distinct files get the same relativePath and a solo name with a backslash restores as a nested directory.
knownDefects.reproduction: Create back\slash.txt next to a back/slash.txt directory, run the tree walk and copy, compare relative paths.

knownDefects.summary: WorkspaceFactory.cleanup removes any path inside the data root, including the data root itself, instead of refusing paths that are not workspace-shaped.
knownDefects.expectedBehavior: Refuse paths that are not workspace-shaped and leave the data untouched.
knownDefects.actualBehavior: cleanup returns cleaned:true and removes the target, including the whole data root.
knownDefects.reproduction: Call WorkspaceFactory.cleanup with the data root, an empty string or an inner managed-copy directory.
